metadata.rules_text:
- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.7) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 5–10% for next 3–5 days.  
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., >15% from prior day), model often overshoots; cap forecast at +10% above peak for 2–3 days.  
- If true outcome shows sudden drop after a spike, model fails to adjust; add a 3–5 day lag correction: forecast = true - 2–3 days’ average drop.  
- When sentiment is negative (≤ -0.5) and price is falling, model underestimates; add 3–5% upward bias to forecast for next 3 days.  
- Model consistently underestimates in 30-day horizon when sentiment is mixed (±0.3–0.5); apply 5–8% upward adjustment for 10–15 day horizon.  
- If true outcome deviates >10% from 14-day moving average, model is biased; use 14-day MA as anchor for correction.  
- For 30-day forecasts, if true outcome is >15% above model, assume sentiment-driven overreaction; reduce forecast by 5–10% for next 5 days.
